verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents employer-side immigration services: H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E, PERM and green cards. It also tracks expirations and extensions across employees and sets compliance policies "as your workforce moves and grows," so a hiring manager could plausibly run multiple employees' visas through one firm. However, there is no stated startup or scale-up program, and no multi-case or employer dashboard; the documented portal and dedicated-attorney pairing are described per individual case. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-case/team management offering or employer portal view, a stated startup/scale-up program, volume or team pricing, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: We help employers secure H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E, and other work visas, providing clear strategy, careful preparation, and steady communication.
We track expirations and plan extensions, amendments, and next steps early, so your employees stay authorized without disruption.
We help you set policies that keep filings accurate as your workforce moves and grows.
We guide employers through the annual cap, lottery selection process, and critical filing timelines so hiring plans stay on track.
